scope.purpose: Assign every parsed raw terminology occurrence either to the Task 4.1B PINN-related candidate pool or explicitly outside Task 4.1B, then give every selected candidate a controlled provisional disposition without canonical promotion.
scope.outside_scope_note: Terms outside the PINN-related candidate pool remain relevant to the future all-review Abbreviation Registry and are not deleted or normalized here.
